notifications.conception.lhTest.body: Eli lixesha elifanelekileyo lokwenza uvavanyo lwakho lwe-LH.

help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Ndiliqopha njani ixesha lam lenyanga?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Yongeza iintsuku kunye nobude bexesha lakho lenyanga.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Kwikhalenda okanye kwiJenali yemihla ngemihla, qopha ukuba ixesha lakho lenyanga liqala nini, lihlala ixesha elingakanani, kwanobuninzi bokopha. Olu lwazi lwakha imbali yakho kwaye lukhokela uqikelelo olubonakalayo ku-AWA.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Ndingayilungisa na imini yexesha lam lenyanga?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Lungisa umhla ukuba ukulandelela kwakho kutshintshile.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Ewe. Lungisa umhla ofanelekileyo kulandelelo lwakho ukuze imbali yakho ihlale ichanekile ngokomjikelo wakho wenene. Uqikelelo lunokutshintsha ngokoluhlu olutsha olugcinwe.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Ixesha lam lenyanga elilandelayo libalwa njani?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Uqikelelo olusekelwe kwimbali yakho.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: I-AWA iqikelela ixesha lakho lenyanga elilandelayo, iwindow yobuzaleli kunye ne-ovulation ngokwembali yakho, ubude bomjikelo wakho, nolwazi olurekhodayo. Uqikelelo alusoloko lusekelwe kumjikelo oqhelekileyo weentsuku ezingama-28 kuphela.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Ndilandelela njani ubuninzi bokopha kwam?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Qopha indlela ukopha okutshintsha ngayo.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Sebenzisa iJenali yemihla ngemihla ukuphawula ubuninzi bokopha kwakho kwexesha lenyanga. Oku kugcina imbali yendlela okutshintsha ngayo kwimijikelo yakho.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Zithetha ukuthini iimpawu zekhalenda?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Ixesha lenyanga, ubuzaleli, i-ovulation nekhalenda yeHijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Ikhalenda ibonisa iintsuku zexesha lakho lenyanga eziqoshiweyo kunye newindow yakho yobuzaleli ejongelwe ne-ovulation. Ukuba iimpawu zokomoya zivuliwe, umhla weHijri ungabonakala kunye nomhla weGregorian.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Jonga iintsuku ezijongelwe ukuba zezona zinobuzaleli obuphezulu.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Kwimo yokuzama ukukhulelwa, i-AWA ibonisa iwindow yobuzaleli ejongelwe ngokolwazi lomjikelo wakho nembali yakho.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: I-ovulation yam ijongelwa njani?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Uqikelelo olutshintsha njengoko ulandelela.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: I-ovulation iqikelelwa ngolwazi olukhoyo kwimbali yomjikelo wakho. Olu qikelelo lunokutshintsha njengoko wongeza idatha entsha.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Ndingalandelela na ubushushu bomzimba wam?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Yongeza ubushushu bakho kulandelelo lwakho lobuzaleli.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Ewe. Ukulandelela ubushushu bomzimba kuyinxalenye yemo ekhethekileyo yokukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Yongeza oku kuqwalaselwa kulandelelo lwakho lobuzaleli.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Ewe. Ukulandelela i-cervical mucus yenye yeenkcukacha ezifumanekayo kwimo yokuzama ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Ndingarekhoda na uvavanyo lwe-ovulation lwe-LH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Gcina iziphumo zakho kulandelelo lwakho.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Ewe. Ukurekhoda uvavanyo lwe-ovulation lwe-LH kuyinxalenye yohambo lokukhulelwa.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Ndiyirekhoda njani indlela yokulala nomlingane?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Iinkcukacha zobuqu kwijenali yakho.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Icandelo le-Intimacy likuvumela ukuba urekhode ubudlelwane basebuhlotyeni nolunye ulwazi oluhambelanayo. Eli candelo lihlala liyimfihlo kwaye linokukhuselwa ngokwahlukileyo.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Zeziphi iindlela zokuthintela ukukhulelwa endinokuzilandelela?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Ipilisi, isangqa, ipatch nonyango lwehormone.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: I-AWA ixhasa ukulandelela ipilisi yokuthintela ukukhulelwa, isangqa sasebusweni besini, ipatch yokuthintela ukukhulelwa, nolunye unyango lwehormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Ewe. I-AWA inikezela ngezikhumbuzo ezilungiselelwa wena zokusela ipilisi yakho, kunye neziqinisekiso zemihla ngemihla.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Ewe. Ukulandelela iidosi ezilityiwe kuyinxalenye yohambo lokuthintela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Ndingayifumana phi imbali yokusela kwam?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Phinda ujonge iidosi ezirekhodiweyo namapilisi alityiwe.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Imbali yokusela iyafumaneka ukugcina irekhodi yokulandelela kwakho indlela yokuthintela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Ingaba uqikelelo lusenengxaki ngoxa ndisebenzisa indlela yokuthintela ukukhulelwa?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Ezinye iindlela zinokutshintsha umjikelo wakho wemvelo.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: I-AWA inokuqhubeka ibonisa ulwazi lokulandelela olukhoyo, kodwa indlela oluqonda ngayo uqikelelo ixhomekeke kwimeko yakho nendlela oyisebenzisayo. Ayithathi ndawo yeengcebiso zezonyango.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Ingaba umjikelo omde uthathwa "njengolibeleyo"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: I-AWA ithatha imijikelo engaqhelekanga ngokuqwalasela.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Hayi. Kwimo ye-SOPK/Imijikelo engaqhelekanga, i-AWA ayiwuthathi ngokuzenzekelayo umjikelo omde "njengolibeleyo."
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Zeziphi iimpawu endinokuzilandelela nge-PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Jonga iimpawu ezitshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela kubandakanya imijikelo engaqhelekanga, iziphumo ebusweni, ukukhula kweenwele, utshintsho lobunzima nezinye iimpawu ezihambelanayo.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Ndingalandelela na iziphumo ebusweni nokukhula kweenwele?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Yongeza oko ukuqwalaselileyo kulandelelo lwakho lwe-PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Ewe. Iziphumo ebusweni nokukhula kweenwele zisecaleni ngokucacileyo lokulandelela okulungiselelwe i-PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Ndingalandelela na utshintsho lobunzima bam?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Jonga indlela ubunzima bakho obutshintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwexesha.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Ewe. Ukulandelela ubunzima kuyafumaneka kwimo ye-PCOS/Imijikelo engaqhelekanga.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Kutheni uqikelelo lwam lutshintsha kakhulu?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Imijikelo engaqhelekanga yenza uqikelelo lungazinzi.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Xa imijikelo ingaqhelekanga, uqikelelo lunokutshintsha ngakumbi ngokwemvelo. I-AWA isebenzisa imbali yakho ngaphandle kokuthatha ngokuzenzekelayo umjikelo omde njengolibeleyo.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Zeziphi iimpawu endinokuzilandelela?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Ukulandelela okulungiselelwe utshintsho lweli nqanaba lobomi.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela kubandakanya hot flashes, ukubila ebusuku, iingxaki zokulala, ukudinwa, utshintsho lweemvakalelo nokulibala, phakathi kwezinye.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Ndingazirekhoda na iihot flashes zam?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Jonga indlela ezihlala zibakho ngayo ngokuhamba kwexesha.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Ewe. Iihot flashes ziyenye yeempawu ezifumanekayo kwimo ye-Perimenopause/Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Ndingalandelela na ukulala nokudinwa kwam?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Jonga iingxaki zokulala nokudinwa.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Ewe. Iingxaki zokulala, ukubila ebusuku nokudinwa zonke ziyafumaneka kolu hambo.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Ewe. Unokulandelela unyango lwehormone njengenxalenye yale mo.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Ndingazirekhoda na iziphumo zam ze-FSH ne-estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Yongeza ezinye iziphumo zelebhu kulandelelo lwakho.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Ewe. Iziphumo zelebhu ezifana ne-FSH ne-estradiol zinokurekhodwa kule mo.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Umhla wam wokuzala ubalwa njani?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Uqikelelo olubonakalayo kulandelelo lwakho lokukhulelwa.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa kubala umhla wakho wokuzala ojongelwe ngokolwazi olukhoyo kulandelelo lwakho.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Ndingalandelela na ukukhulelwa kwam iveki ngeveki?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Jonga ukuqhubeka kokukhulelwa kwakho iveki ngeveki.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Ewe. I-AWA inikezela ngokulandelela iveki ngeveki kwaye ibonisa indlela ukukhulelwa kwakho okuqhubeka ngayo.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Ndingazirekhoda na iidinga zam zezonyango?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Gcina iidinga zakho ezibalulekileyo kwindawo enye.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Ewe. Iidinga zezonyango novavanyo olubalulekileyo zisecaleni lokulandelela ukukhulelwa.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Ndingafumana na izikhumbuzo zovavanyo lwam?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Misela izikhumbuzo ozilungiselele wena.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Ewe. Izikhumbuzo ezilungiselelwe wena zeedinga novavanyo olubalulekileyo ziyafumaneka.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Ndingalandelela ntoni ngexesha lokukhulelwa kwam?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Iimpawu, ubunzima, imvakalelo, ukulala nolwazi lobuqu.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Ukulandelela ukukhulelwa kunokubandakanya iimpawu ozivayo, ubunzima, imvakalelo, ukulala nolwazi lobuqu lezonyango.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Ndiyilandelela njani i-lochia yam?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Jonga ubude bexesha nendlela ukuphuma kutshintsha ngayo.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Ukulandelela emva kokuzala kubandakanya ubude be-lochia, indlela ukopha okutshintsha ngayo, neempawu ezihambelanayo.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.questio: Ndilandelela njani ukubuya kwexesha lam lenyanga?
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.subtitl: Jonga umjikelo wakho ubuya kancinci kancinci.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: I-AWA ilandelela ukubuya komjikelo wakho, ukuqalisa kwakhona kwexesha lakho lenyanga, notshintsho lwehormone emva kokuzala.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Gcina olu lwazi kuhambo lwakho lwasemva kokuzala.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Ewe. Ukuncancisa nokungabikho kwexesha lenyanga emva kokuzala kuyinxalenye yokulandelela okufumanekayo.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Ndingalandelela ntoni ngexesha lokuphila kwam?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Ukudinwa, ukulala, imvakalelo, intlungu nokuphila komzimba.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Ukulandelela kwemihla ngemihla emva kokuzala kubandakanya ukudinwa, ukulala, imvakalelo, intlungu nokuphila komzimba, phakathi kwezinye.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: I-AWA iyiphatha njani i-nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Uphawu lokonqulo, olwahlukileyo kulandelelo lwezonyango.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Xa iimpawu zokomoya zivuliwe, i-AWA inokulandelela ixesha lokopha emva kokuzala kwaye ibonise indawo yesalathiso ye-nifas ngokwesalathiso sonqulo osikhethileyo. Ubude obukhulu bunokwahluka phakathi kweemfundiso zezikolo zokucinga kwaye abusoloko bubonisiwe njengenyaniso enye xa izimvo zahlukile.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Ndilandelela njani ukopha kwam?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Jonga indlela okutshintsha ngayo, ungakhawulezi ubuyele kulandelelo oluqhelekileyo.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Uhambo lwe-Emva kokuphuma kwesisu lulandelela ukopha nendlela okutshintsha ngayo, kwindawo elungiselelwe eli xesha.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Ndilandelela njani ukubuya komjikelo wam?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Phinda uqalise ukulandelela ngesantya sakho.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: I-AWA ilandelela ukubuya komjikelo wakho emva kokuphuma kwesisu, ikuvumela ukuba uqhubeke kancinci kancinci nembali yakho ngaphandle kokuphoqa ukulandelela ixesha lenyanga kwangoko.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Zeziphi iimpawu endinokuzirekhoda?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Landelela iimpawu zomzimba ofuna ukuziphawula.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Ukulandelela iimpawu zomzimba kuyafumaneka kolu hambo.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Ndingagcina na amanqaku obuqu?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Indawo yobuqu kwijenali yakho.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Ewe. Amanqaku obuqu ayafumaneka ukukuphelekisa kweli xesha.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Ndingabuyela na ekuzameni ukukhulelwa emva koko?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Tshintsha injongo yakho nanini na xa ufuna ukuzama kwakhona.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Inkxaso yokuqalisa kwakhona ukuzama ukukhulelwa ikhona. Ukutshintsha injongo yakho kuhamba kancinci kancinci kwaye kusoloko kuyisigqibo sakho.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Ikhalenda yeHijri isebenza njani?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Ibonisa umhla weHijri kunye nomhla weGregorian.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Xa iimpawu zokomoya zivuliwe, i-AWA inokubonisa umhla weHijri kunye nomhla weGregorian kwaye iphawule iinyanga ezibalulekileyo ezifana neRamadan okanye iDhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Ithetha ntoni imo yococeko?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Uphawu oluyimfihlo oluhlobene nokuqalisa kwakhona unqulo.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: I-AWA inokubonisa umqondiso oyimfihlo owahlula ixesha lakho lenyanga kwixesha lakho lococeko xa iimpawu zokomoya zivuliwe.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: I-AWA ibonisa njani xa umthandazo uqalisa kwakhona?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Uphawu olusekelwe kwixesha lokuphela kwexesha lakho lenyanga.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Ukuba ucoceko lubuya phambi kokuba iwindow yomthandazo wangoku iphele, i-app inokuphawula ukuba lo mthandazo uyabuya ufuneka. Imithandazo elityiwe ngexesha lenyanga ayibalwa njengemithandazo yokuphindiswa.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Ukulandelela iintsuku zokuzila ekufuneka ziphindwe kusebenza njani?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Kubala iintsuku ezilityiwe ngenxa yexesha lakho lenyanga.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: I-AWA inokunikezela ngekhawunta yeentsuku zokuzila ezilityiwe ngenxa yexesha lakho lenyanga, ngakumbi ngexesha leRamadan, kunye nesikhumbuzo esithambileyo emva kwenyanga sokucwangcisa ukuziphinda.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: I-nifas ibonisiwe njani?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Uphawu olunokwahluka phakathi kweemfundiso zezikolo zokucinga.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: I-AWA inokubonisa isalathiso sonqulo osikhethileyo sobude obukhulu be-nifas, iphawula ukwahluka phakathi kweemfundiso apho umxholo ovunyiweyo ubuqulatha khona. I-app ayiwubonisi nanini na umlinganiselo omnye njengenyaniso engenakuphikiswa.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: I-AWA inikezela ngeengcebiso ze-istihada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Umxholo wemfundo, hayi ifatwa elungiselelwe wena.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: I-AWA inokunikezela ngomxholo jikelele wemfundo ngo-istihada nokuthetha kwayo kwinkonzo. I-app ayikhupheli ifatwa elungiselelwe wena, kwaye umxholo wonqulo ujoliswe ukuba uvunywe ligunya eliqatshelweyo.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Ndingarekhoda ntoni kwijenali yam?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Iimpawu, imvakalelo, ubudlelwane basebuhlotyeni, ukulala nokunyakaza.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: IJenali yemihla ngemihla ibandakanya iimpawu zomzimba, imo yeemvakalelo, ubudlelwane basebuhlotyeni, ukulala, umsebenzi womzimba, namanqaku obuqu.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Iimpawu, imvakalelo, ukulala, ukunyakaza, ukusela amanzi, ukopha kwexesha lenyanga namanqaku.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: IJenali yemihla ngemihla ikuvumela ukuba ulandelele iimpawu zomzimba, imvakalelo, ukulala, umsebenzi womzimba, ukusela amanzi, ukopha kwexesha lenyanga, namanqaku obuqu.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Ngaba icandelo lam le-Intimacy lingakhuselwa?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Icandelo eliyimfihlo, elahlukileyo.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Ewe. Icandelo le-Intimacy lingafihlwa likhuselwe nge-PIN okanye i-Face ID yalo eyahlukileyo.
